en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. `Ali Majiluwayh (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim narrated to us from his father Ibrahim b. Hashim from `Ali b. Mu`abbad from al-Husayn b. Khalid from Abi’l Hasan `Ali b. Musa al-Rida from his father from his forefathers (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:
Whoever is a Muslim should not scheme or deceive others, for surely, I heard Gabriel (as) say: “Scheming and deception are in the Fire.”
